glossary.definition: A record that lists, for each severity rating, the role to be notified, the expected time for a first response, and the fallback role if no response is received.
The record of all ratings assigned to a report, showing the original rating, any subsequent changes, the name of the person who made each change, the date, and the stated reason.

A record kept apart from the severity scale that lists each applicable jurisdiction, the authority responsible, the contact for questions, and the contractual or regulatory duties that may require external notice following an incident.
